recommendations: Keep Scene 1 under 3.0s with a bold 4-to-7 word hook headline and active camera punch-in to maximize 3s thumbstop retention.
Place primary talking-head copy in the chest optical zone (1040px-1260px) or upper band (220px-360px) to clear TikTok, Reels, and Shorts bottom/right chrome.
Insert a visual progression (cut, wrapper zoom, callout card, or cursor action) every 1.8s-3.2s to prevent mid-reel viewer drop-off.
Use Original Voice Auto-Sync for authentic on-camera founder/retailer pitches, and switch to Bengali, English, or Hindi AI lip-sync for localized ad variants.
